root_cause.text: The v11 MQD manager incorrectly assigned the CP-compute checkpoint_mqd and restore_mqd functions to SDMA queues, causing memcpy operations to use sizeof(struct v11_compute_mqd) (2048 bytes) instead of sizeof(struct v11_sdma_mqd) (512 bytes), resulting in a 1536-byte buffer overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `mqd_manager_init_v11`, for `KFD_MQD_TYPE_SDMA`, the function pointers `mqd->checkpoint_mqd` and `mqd->restore_mqd` were set to the generic `checkpoint_mqd` and `restore_mqd` (which use `struct v11_compute_mqd`). The fix replaces them with new SDMA-specific functions `checkpoint_mqd_sdma` and `restore_mqd_sdma` that use `struct v11_sdma_mqd`. The CVE description explicitly states: "The v11 MQD manager incorrectly assigned the CP-compute variants of checkpoint_mqd/restore_mqd for KFD_MQD_TYPE_SDMA queues. These functions use sizeof(struct v11_compute_mqd) (2048 bytes) instead of sizeof(struct v11_sdma_mqd) (512 bytes), causing a 1536-byte overflow."
